verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares is an equity-management SaaS, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only UI workflows and a Gusto integration, with no API keys, tokens, or permission scoping. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
